errors.text: The hypothesis places the principal antiferromagnetic coupling across the fcc/C14 interface and characterizes the C14 phase as antiferromagnetic or paramagnetic, whereas the target reports ferromagnetic ground states for both phases and antiparallel coupling between Fe/Co/Ni and Ti sublattices.
It does not reconstruct the phase-specific transition assignment: approximately 214 K is associated with C14, while approximately 1084 K and 168 K originate from fcc.
